graph.title: TTX Intermodal Double-Stack Car

new_part_types.name: Bogie buffer beam with two buffers
Bogie top plate with centre pin

notes: This PDF has no inventory pages, so Element IDs are inferred from the pictures. I used catalogue types where the shape matched and set colour in props. Several types are only the closest shape match, for example lego-303226 for the 4x6 plates and lego-486501 for the yellow 1x2x2 panels.

Part ids in the instructions are not given, so ids are mine. The two flatcar halves are repeat 'car' x2 (car1, car2). The three small containers are repeat 'cargo' x3 (cargo1 blue, cargo2 red, cargo3 white). The two end modules of the gray container are repeat 'gmod' x2.
Some stacking edges are approximate, especially which stud sits on which brick in the side-wall and top-rail layers. The pictures are small, so the exact stud-to-stud adjacency is a best reading.

Step-by-step counts follow the parts boxes. The centre bogie (pages 19-20) is built once and joins both cars with two red pins. The pins are shown only as step 16 'join the two cars', so I attach each pin to the car base plate.
The car at the handrail end sits on its own end bogie (pages 16-17), which is built twice, once per car. Its centre pin goes into the base plate.

The gray container sits on car1 and the red container stacks on it. The white container sits on car2 and the blue container stacks on it, as on page 31. The cover and the last page show a different stacking arrangement.
Container feet (the L-shaped plates under each container) are shown upside down in the instructions. I modelled them as plates whose studs go into the underside of the base plate.
Printed stickers (CARGO, TTX, 125T, 8) are not modelled as parts.
